name: Shoukoujo
source:
The protagonist left his hometown to attend a prestigious prep school, but now, with the chance to enroll in a famous university back home, he returns to where he was born and raised.

Having spent his teenage years at an all-boys school, starved of any interaction with girls, he dreamed of a carefree college life where he could live alone and finally get close to some girls.
But his parents weren’t about to let him live alone near home without consequences—his allowance was slashed. To make ends meet, he decides to put his skills to use and starts working as a private tutor.

His students? Four adorable girls.

Alone with them in their private space, the protagonist—who’d wished to date a younger girl—finds himself in paradise. Seizing the opportunity, he starts pulling out all the stops to win them over.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171107025637/http://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/views_0541/]DMM[/url]]
translation:
主人公离开家乡，去一所著名的预科学校就读，而现在，他有机会考入家乡的一所著名大学，回到了他出生和长大的地方。

他在一所男子学校度过了青少年时期，渴望与女孩进行任何互动，他梦想着过上无忧无虑的大学生活，在那里他可以独自生活，并最终与一些女孩接近。
但他的父母并不打算让他独自住在家附近而不承担任何后果——他的津贴被削减了。为了维持生计，他决定发挥自己的技能，开始担任私人导师。

他的学生？四个可爱的女孩。

与他们单独呆在私人空间里的主角——原本想和一个年轻女孩约会——发现自己身处天堂。他抓住了这个机会，开始使出浑身解数来赢得他们的支持。

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171107025637/http://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/views_0541/]DMM[/url]]
